projects.title: Remote Trackpad & Gamepad Pro — Turn Smartphone into PC Trackpad & Gamepad

bullets: Engineered an open-source wireless peripheral ecosystem transforming Android devices into a glass trackpad, 3-mode console gamepad (Xbox/PS), and mechanical keyboard for Windows PCs.

projects.title: Remote Trackpad Web — Turn Smartphone Browser into PC Mouse
